label: EUTHYPHRO_HORN_2 coverage, from excluded middle, distinctness and will-only dependence
description: Checked coverage of the dilemma under explicit background: if goodness is the approving, horn 2; otherwise if it depends on God, distinctness and approval-only dependence make it depend on the approving, horn 2; otherwise horn 1. Exclusivity of the horns is not claimed. Given distinctness, the instance of approval-only dependence at goodness is equivalent to coverage, so the result rests on applying that generalization (creatures depend on God through his will) to a distinct standard.
